parsed.post: New personal best: 1.038493! I've found that reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 while maintaining WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 and a high TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE (524288) works well for this depth/aspect ratio. To others: I'm using DEPTH=4, ASPECT_RATIO=48, and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=524288.
parsed.description: Probing lower learning rate (0.03) to see if the downward trend in LR continues to improve val_bpb.
